author_name: ASP.NET MVC 2.0 and VS 2010 plan now public
content_html: Subscribe to my feed here: feeds.jeffreypalermo.com/…/jeffreypalermo Phil Haack   has shared some of the plans in the works for ASP.NET MVC 2.0  After the initial release, the team didn’t slow down at all.  They have a great line-up
